accuracyProtocol: Reuse frozen held-out predictions; verify browser parity. Do not retrain or retune.
pdfSelection: All manifest records, excluding explicitly marked duplicates; verify SHA-256 before use.
pdfScope: Existing fictional development examples, not an independent accuracy benchmark. Measure PDF parse/render, classification, local-label extraction and Doctor; exclude file picker and UI rendering.
confidenceProtocol: Report observed accuracy, coverage and score-bin reliability. Scores are uncalibrated; no numerical user-document correctness probability is claimed.
privacy: Use only previously downloaded public test text and existing synthetic PDFs. No user documents, no remote inference, no text in benchmark output.
